mapper.select: SELECT id, company_id, policy_id, score, grade, score_breakdown::text AS score_breakdown, matched_at, expires_at, viewed_at, applied_at FROM policy_match_score WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND expires_at > now() ORDER BY score DESC, matched_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM policy_match_score WHERE expires_at <= now()
